newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar production to be revised up.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar production to be revised up.

text.p: The European Union's beet sugar production estimate will be revised sharply upwards at Wednesday's management committee meeting, a diplomatic source said on Tuesday.
"The weekly sugar management committee meeting will be presented with a revised balance sheet showing that beet sugar production will exceed last years total," the source said.
Last Wednesday the eighth revision put total EU beet sugar production at 15,580 million tonnes compared with 15,636 million in 1995/96.
France has increased its production estimate by 150,000 tonnes to a new total of 4.2 million tonnes from 4.05 million, the source said.
Italy and Belgium have indicated that they will be increasing their estimates by a similar amount based on the latest production figures.
"The turnaround in the EU beet crop is remarkable. In September forecasts predicted that the crop would be down by 220,000 tonnes or 14 percent on the last season," the source said.
Forecasts were based on dry conditions and a fall in plantings but good Autumn weather and a disease-free crop throughout the EU has reversed the projections, the source added.
